Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 37: the slip of [[Levitation Attack (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“▼ (or retrieve) a device (for free). [Immune to Sense] OR Cancel Sabotage targeting a device. OR During battle, place your weapon or device present in Used Pile to add 2 to your total power (3 if Vader present).”), word for word the text of [[Levitation Attack (V) (Errata)|Levitation Attack (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
